# PokéHabitat notices

This offline distribution preserves the PokéHabitat fan project interface and content.
Pokémon names, creatures and artwork are © Nintendo, Creatures Inc. and GAME FREAK Inc.
The local Pokémon artwork and catalogue were captured from the published PokéHabitat project,
whose source data/artwork attribution is PokéAPI (https://pokeapi.co/).
Redistribution does not transfer ownership of Pokémon intellectual property.

The six habitat images and SVG favicon are the bundled visual assets of the PokéHabitat project.
No remote artwork service, web font or CDN is used at runtime.

`DEPENDENCIES.md` in the generated client distribution contains complete notices and licenses
for the JavaScript packages actually bundled by Vite (React, React DOM, Radix UI, Lucide and
other transitive packages). Build tooling is pinned in `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`;
it is not installed on the deployed node to serve browser files.
